children: RXO reported stronger-than-expected truckload gross profit per load, with August up more than 10% vs July and Q3 volume poised to increase low-to-mid single digits year-over-year.
Truckload gross profit per load rose by more than 10% in August versus July, beating prior outlook.
Spot freight made up about 50% of full-truckload volume through the first two months of the quarter.
Company is phasing in higher contract rates while leveraging scale to purchase transportation effectively.
RXO continues to expect third-quarter truckload volume to increase by a low-to-mid single digit percentage year-over-year.
